Base barplot

base_barplot.Rd

Can be used as base for combo of bar and line plot as well. All the info is in the datapoints and config.

Usage

base_barplot(datapoints, config, y_axis, forecast = NULL, pad = x_pad("bar"))

Arguments

datapoints

list of dataframes from prep_data

config

config dictionary list from prep_config

y_axis

output of find_pretty_ylim

forecast

forecast param

pad

numeric or vector of length 2 for xlim edge padding

Value

midpoints, of course also plots a barplot to open device
